prova:
intro r h2
  have h2' : r ≥ 2 := h2
  have hr_pos : 0 < r := by omega
  have h_full_0 : Nat.Full r 0 := by
    refine ⟨0, 0, Nat.mul_one 0⟩
  have h_full_1 : Nat.Full r 1 := by
    refine ⟨0, 1, Nat.mul_one 1⟩
  refine ⟨fun n => ⟨List.rep (r + 1) 1, by simp [List.length_rep], fun x => h_full_1, Nat.mul_one n⟩⟩
